name: Miniature Murmur Turtle #3
description:
A small turtle approximately 5 cm in length. Its shell appears to be slightly translucent, revealing faint patterns resembling sound waves. The turtle continuously emits a soft murmur.

EFFECT: Induces relaxation and mild happiness to nearby subjects through auditory means.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The creature emits a soft, continuous murmur that induces a mild calming effect in subjects within a 2-meter radius.
TASTE: Not applicable.
PACKAGING: A small, transparent plastic container with a breathable lid. Contains air holes and resembles a typical pet store packaging for fish or small reptiles.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Finally, a pet that doubles as a therapist. Might swap my goldfish for this one.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-06-21 — edition #3 of the permanent record.
